summary: Re-recorded the account for the five-voter discard receipt 29f7b510513642f499f8646cb55dccfe after a state check showed my earlier attempt at it had been replaced inside its own turn and never accepted (only the last-written draft of a turn is read). The account now records that on a five-voter committed configuration the restarted holder acknowledged one payload on a single copy (discard_inputs at parsed index 35: five committed voters against one in its snapshot metadata), a majority that never held it elected leadership at term 3 and then again at term 4, and once the holder was rebuilt the payload was absent from every store — comparison 1 holds at parsed index 36 with discarded true, payload_on_holder_after false and copies_after_rejoin 0, comparison 0 is violated at the same index because the acknowledged commit was not durable on a majority of the committed configuration, and the flag-disabled control acknowledged nothing at parsed index 38. Added the loss fact for that receipt, qualified the earlier three-voter fact as shape-specific through its conditions and changed premise, withdrew the previously recorded limitation that the discard was unexercised, and restated the whole account with each result under its own receipt. This submission is the turn's only write; the boundaries that remain are the recorded limitations: in-memory single-process execution with no crash or fault model, single-shot windows, one restarted instance per exercise, a synthesized campaign for the vote-path request, and the four exercised ladders only.
